name: First Steps
description: Learn the basics of movement, inventory, and combat.

steps.name: Open Your Inventory
steps.description: Open your inventory to see the items you carry.
steps.hint: Press the inventory key or click the inventory button on the HUD.

steps.name: Travel to the Village Square
steps.description: Move to the Village Square to meet the locals.
steps.hint: Use the world map or walk towards the marked location.

steps.name: Check Your Equipment
steps.description: Open the equipment panel and review your current gear.
steps.hint: Your equipment slots are shown in the character panel.

steps.name: Use Your First Ability
steps.description: Try using a basic ability in a safe area.
steps.hint: Select an ability from your skill bar and activate it.

name: Combat Basics
description: Learn how to fight enemies and survive encounters.

steps.name: Find a Training Dummy
steps.description: Locate the training dummy near the village square.
steps.hint: Training dummies are marked with a white sword icon on the map.

steps.name: Perform a Light Attack
steps.description: Use a light attack against the training dummy.
steps.hint: Left-click or press the light attack key.

steps.name: Perform a Heavy Attack
steps.description: Use a heavy attack to deal more damage.
steps.hint: Hold the attack button or use the heavy attack keybind.

name: Crafting Fundamentals
description: Learn to gather materials and craft basic items.

steps.name: Gather Materials
steps.description: Gather wood and stone from resource nodes.
steps.hint: Look for glowing nodes in the forest area.

steps.name: Open the Crafting Menu
steps.description: Access the crafting interface to view recipes.
steps.hint: Press the crafting key or select it from the menu.

steps.name: Craft Your First Item
steps.description: Craft a wooden practice sword using the gathered materials.
steps.hint: Select the recipe and confirm the craft.
